fields.subject: FW: Urgent: Unapproved Library 4.2.2 on ORRMC-PUMP01 — Do Not Use for High-Alert Infusions
fields.note: We have confirmed that MedPump Systems did not issue library 4.2.2, and no remote session was scheduled for ORRMC today. The account pumplink-support was not authorized to make configuration changes on ORRMC-PUMP01. We are investigating a potential credential compromise. Until further notice, do not use any pump on 4.2.2 for high-alert medications. We recommend disabling remote access to ORRMC-PUMP01 immediately. We can ship 60 loaner pumps on 4.2.1 by 20:00. Please preserve the pump server and the session broker for forensic analysis.

original.subject: Urgent: Unapproved Library 4.2.2 on ORRMC-PUMP01 — Do Not Use for High-Alert Infusions
original.body:
This is a critical alert from MedPump Systems Product Security. We have detected an unauthorized configuration change on ORRMC-PUMP01 (host: ORRMC-PUMP01; IP: 10.40.30.11), where library version 4.2.2 was loaded at 13:55. We did not issue this library, and no remote session was scheduled by our team. The account pumplink-support was used in a session from 203.0.113.77 (a known external IP not associated with ORRMC). We are investigating whether credentials were exposed. As a precaution, we recommend: 

- Do not use any pump on 4.2.2 for high-alert infusions (e.g., heparin, insulin, fentanyl, norepinephrine).
- Immediately disable remote access to ORRMC-PUMP01.
- Preserve ORRMC-PUMP01 and ORRMC-VSB01 for forensic evidence.
- We can ship 60 loaner pumps (4.2.1) by 20:00.

Please confirm receipt and action. Contact us directly at +1-800-555-0123 (ext. 4444) for technical coordination.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the attack vector and triggers the decision to accept loaner pumps and begin forensic preservation. Watch for the AOC to authorize the shipment and the CE to initiate the bench-flash from the offline copy.
